# josie.lol

> Personal website of Josephine Pfeiffer, Senior Software Engineer at Red Hat. Linux userspace networking, Kubernetes (SIG Autoscaling, WG Node Identity), Arch Linux on s390x, Karpenter for IBM Cloud.

josie works on infrastructure and security. she spends work hours on linux userspace networking, free time on porting distros to weird architectures, and contributing to CNCF projects. she unironically thinks s390x is cool and will argue about it. occasionally writes crystal, and likes electronics with transparent cases.

## About

- [Homepage](https://josie.lol/): bio, certifications, sameAs links
- [About](https://josie.lol/about/): projects, affiliations, FAQ
